headline: 'I'll never trust them again': Some Afghans who helped the U.S. post-9/11 regret it
context: Soon after the Sept. 11 attacks, the U.S. launched what would become a 20-year war in Afghanistan. Some Afghans who helped the U.S. prosecute that war regret it.
